experience.career_desc: This section highlights projects that, although independent, are part of the core of my technical training and ability to solve complex custom problems.

crediagro.summary: Leadership in the democratization of agricultural financing (BNPL), connecting more than 50,000 actors across the agricultural value chain through digital financial inclusion.
crediagro.details: As the founding architect, I led the creation of the infrastructure that now enables more than 50,000 registered users —farmers, agronomists, transporters and other actors across the agricultural value chain— to buy in interest-free installments at partner stores. The platform has already surpassed US$3 million in approved financing lines and US$1 million in processed sales. I materialized the vision of 'Agrooberto', an AI assistant on WhatsApp that digitized 100% of the financing process, from KYC onboarding to checkout, eliminating liquidity barriers and bureaucracy. This ecosystem has not only provided banking services to underserved sectors but has driven a 30% increase in transactions in partner stores, redefining the agricultural economy in Venezuela.

agroo.summary: Cross-functional software architect responsible for the technical execution and scaling of the entire digital ecosystem.
agroo.details: At Agroo, I execute a 360° vision, operating as the technical pillar that supports everything from the transactional core of the business to the development of high-fidelity custom mobile applications for events and market experiences. My work consists of transforming complex ideas into functional technical realities, leading development on all fronts and ensuring the robustness of each solution launched to the market. I am responsible for the technical feasibility and performance of every product released under the brand seal, ensuring that technology is always the engine driving the business.

corpoeureka.summary: Development and optimization of business solutions on the Odoo ecosystem.
corpoeureka.details: At Corpoeureka, my main focus is the development and maintenance of critical modules within Odoo, ensuring the stability and efficiency of business processes. Thanks to the results obtained in projects like Agroo and Crediagro, my technical contributions often serve as a reference for the implementation of new functionalities. I am dedicated to solving complex logic problems and collaborating on the structural sanitation of the code, providing a proactive vision that helps raise the firm's regional standards.

otros.summary: Consolidation of critical milestones in automation and industrial digitization.
otros.details: This space brings together key projects where I have applied my knowledge to solve specific problems in the educational and industrial sectors, from the automation of administrative processes with N8N to the digital transformation of occupational health.

fermin.title: Fermín Toro School
fermin.details: Total digitization of registration processes and administrative communication using WhatsApp API and automated flows with N8N, eliminating manual processes and optimizing representative care.

oleica.title: OLEICA C.A.
oleica.details: Digital transformation of the Occupational Health department. I designed and implemented a system for the massive digitization of medical records and the automated generation of morbidity reports, allowing for real-time statistical analysis.
